settings.title: SECURITY SETTINGS // SERVER-SIDE CONFIG
settings.infoText: These settings are persisted server-side in encrypted storage. Changes take effect immediately and are not included in the public band-data JSON export.
settings.footer: Settings stored in server-side encrypted storage (not in public JSON)
mod.honeytokenDesc: Decoy database records that trigger silent alarms on unauthorized access
mod.honeytokenTip: Plants fake credentials (admin_backup, db-credentials, etc.) in the database. Any access attempt triggers immediate alerting, attacker profiling, and optional counter-measures.
mod.rateLimitDesc: Sliding window rate limit (5 req/10s) with GDPR-compliant IP hashing
mod.rateLimitTip: Enforces 5 requests per 10 seconds per client using SHA-256 hashed IPs. Prevents brute-force attacks and DoS. Fails closed (blocks) if Redis is unavailable.
mod.robotsTrapDesc: Defensive tarpit for bots that ignore Disallow directives
mod.robotsTrapTip: Monitors User-Agent strings against robots.txt rules. Bots that violate Disallow directives receive artificial delays (tarpit) and threat score increases.
mod.threatScoringDesc: Behavioral IDS: assigns threat scores to suspicious request patterns
mod.threatScoringTip: Tracks suspicious patterns per IP: honeytoken access (+5), suspicious UA (+4), robots violation (+3), missing headers (+2), rate limit (+2), generic accept (+1). Auto-escalates through CLEAN → WARN → TARPIT → BLOCK levels.
mod.hardBlockDesc: Permanently block flagged IPs until manually removed or TTL expires
mod.hardBlockTip: Maintains a persistent blocklist in Redis. Auto-populated when threat score exceeds threshold. Default TTL is 7 days. Blocked IPs receive immediate 403 responses.
mod.entropyDesc: Inject noise headers into responses for flagged attacker IPs
mod.entropyTip: Adds 200 random garbage headers to responses for known attackers. Wastes attacker bandwidth and confuses automated scanning tools.
mod.zipBombDesc: Serve compressed junk data to confirmed bots (wastes bot memory/CPU)
mod.zipBombTip: Generates a 10 MB gzip-compressed null-byte payload. When decompressed by bots, it expands massively to exhaust memory/CPU. Only activated for confirmed malicious actors.
mod.alertingDesc: Send Discord/email alerts on critical security events
mod.alertingTip: Sends color-coded alerts via Discord webhook and/or Resend email API. Includes IP hash, User-Agent, threat score, and HTTP method. Deduplication prevents alert flooding (1 per IP+event per 5 min).
mod.suspiciousUaDesc: Block known hacking tools (wfuzz, nikto, sqlmap, etc.) with tarpit delay
mod.suspiciousUaTip: Detects User-Agent strings from known attack tools (wfuzz, nikto, sqlmap, nmap, masscan, etc.) and applies tarpit delays before responding. Increases threat score by +4.
mod.sessionBindingDesc: Bind admin sessions to User-Agent + IP subnet to detect hijacking
mod.sessionBindingTip: Computes a fingerprint from User-Agent + IP /24 subnet for each admin session. If the fingerprint changes mid-session, the session is invalidated (potential hijacking).
param.autoBlockThresholdDesc: Threat score at which IPs are automatically hard-blocked
param.autoBlockThresholdTip: When an IP accumulates this many threat points, it is automatically added to the hard blocklist. Default: 12 points. Lower = more aggressive, higher = more tolerant.
param.maxAlertsDesc: Maximum number of security incidents kept in the alert log
param.tarpitMinDesc: Minimum delay applied to flagged requests
param.tarpitMinTip: The minimum artificial delay (in milliseconds) injected into responses for flagged IPs. Requests are slowed down to waste attacker time.
param.tarpitMaxDesc: Maximum delay applied to flagged requests
param.tarpitMaxTip: The maximum artificial delay (in milliseconds). Actual delay is random between min and max to appear more natural.
param.sessionTtlDesc: Admin session lifetime before re-authentication is required
param.sessionTtlTip: Time in seconds before the admin session expires and requires re-login. Default: 14400s (4 hours). Lower = more secure, higher = more convenient.
param.warnThresholdDesc: Threat score at which WARN level is reached (tarpit applied)
param.warnThresholdTip: IPs reaching this score trigger WARN level. Default: 3 points. At WARN level, tarpit delays may be applied if enabled.
param.tarpitThresholdDesc: Threat score at which TARPIT level is reached (slower responses)
param.tarpitThresholdTip: IPs reaching this score trigger TARPIT level. Default: 7 points. At TARPIT level, all responses are artificially delayed.
param.pointsHoneytokenDesc: Points awarded per honeytoken access event
param.pointsSuspiciousUaDesc: Points awarded for known hacking tool User-Agents
param.pointsRobotsViolationDesc: Points awarded per robots.txt Disallow violation
param.pointsMissingHeadersDesc: Points for requests missing standard browser headers
param.pointsRateLimitDesc: Points awarded when rate limit is exceeded
param.pointsGenericAcceptDesc: Points for requests with generic Accept: */* header
param.discordWebhookDesc: Discord webhook URL for security alerts (overrides env var)
param.discordWebhookTip: Enter a Discord webhook URL to receive real-time security alerts in a Discord channel. This overrides the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable when set.
param.alertEmailDesc: Email address for security alert notifications (overrides env var)
param.alertEmailTip: Enter an email address to receive security alert emails via Resend API. Requires RESEND_API_KEY to be set. This overrides the ADMIN_RESET_EMAIL environment variable when set.
rules.tarpitOnWarnDesc: Apply tarpit delay when threat level reaches WARN
rules.tarpitOnWarnTip: When enabled, IPs that reach WARN threat level (score ≥3) receive artificial response delays. This slows down potential attackers without fully blocking them.
rules.tarpitOnSuspiciousUaDesc: Apply tarpit delay for known hacking tools
rules.tarpitOnSuspiciousUaTip: Applies tarpit delays to requests from known attack tools (nikto, sqlmap, wfuzz, etc.) regardless of their current threat score.
rules.tarpitOnRobotsViolationDesc: Apply tarpit delay for bots ignoring Disallow rules
rules.tarpitOnRobotsViolationTip: Applies artificial delays to bots that access paths forbidden by robots.txt Disallow directives. Slows down unauthorized crawlers.
rules.tarpitOnHoneytokenDesc: Apply tarpit delay when decoy records are accessed
rules.tarpitOnHoneytokenTip: Slows down attackers who access honeytoken records. Applied before other countermeasures to waste attacker time.
rules.tarpitOnBlockDesc: Apply tarpit delay before blocking at BLOCK level
rules.tarpitOnBlockTip: Adds an extra delay before the block response is sent. Wastes maximum attacker time before they realize they are blocked.
rules.zipBombOnBlockDesc: Serve zip bomb payload when threat reaches BLOCK level
rules.zipBombOnBlockTip: When enabled and zip bomb is active, IPs that reach BLOCK level (score ≥12) receive a compressed junk payload instead of normal responses. Extremely aggressive — use with caution.
rules.zipBombOnHoneytokenDesc: Serve zip bomb when honeytoken records are accessed
rules.zipBombOnHoneytokenTip: Honeytoken access is a strong indicator of malicious intent. When enabled, accessing decoy database records triggers an immediate zip bomb response.
rules.zipBombOnRepeatOffenderDesc: Serve zip bomb to IPs with ≥3 blocked incidents
rules.zipBombOnRepeatOffenderTip: IPs that have been blocked 3 or more times are considered repeat offenders. When enabled, they receive zip bomb payloads on any subsequent access attempt.
rules.zipBombOnRobotsViolationDesc: Serve zip bomb to bots violating robots.txt Disallow rules
rules.zipBombOnRobotsViolationTip: When enabled, any bot that ignores robots.txt Disallow rules receives a zip bomb payload. Very aggressive — ensure legitimate crawlers are not affected.
rules.zipBombOnSuspiciousUaDesc: Serve zip bomb to known hacking tools (sqlmap, nikto, etc.)
rules.zipBombOnSuspiciousUaTip: When enabled, requests from known attack tools receive a zip bomb payload immediately. Only triggers for positively identified scanner User-Agents.
rules.zipBombOnRateLimit: Zip bomb on rate limit exceeded
rules.zipBombOnRateLimitDesc: Serve zip bomb when client exceeds rate limit threshold
rules.zipBombOnRateLimitTip: When enabled, clients that exceed the rate limit receive a zip bomb instead of a standard 429 response. Extremely aggressive — may affect legitimate users behind shared IPs.
mod.sqlBackfireDesc: Return poisoned SQL data that corrupts the attacker's scanner database
mod.sqlBackfireTip: When a scanner probes for SQL injections, the server responds with SQL commands (DROP TABLE, DELETE, corrupt inserts) embedded in the response body and headers. These payloads target the scanner's local analysis database (e.g. sqlmap's SQLite session store).
rules.sqlBackfireOnScannerDesc: Activate when SQL injection patterns are detected in requests
rules.sqlBackfireOnHoneytokenDesc: Return poisoned SQL data when honeytokens are accessed
mod.canaryDocumentsDesc: Trackable decoy documents in tarpit directories that phone home when opened
mod.canaryDocumentsTip: Places realistic-looking documents (credentials, DB exports, API keys) in tarpit directories like /admin/backup/. When an attacker downloads and opens them, embedded tracking reveals their real IP, OS, browser, timezone, and screen resolution — even behind proxies (via WebRTC STUN). Additionally, every robots.txt honeypot 403 page embeds canary tracking, so all collected forensic data is stored in the attacker profile.
rules.canaryPhoneHomeDesc: Embed tracking callbacks that fire when documents are opened
rules.canaryFingerprintDesc: Gather timezone, screen size, language, WebRTC IP from the opener
rules.canaryAlertDesc: Send Discord/email alert when a canary document phones home
mod.logPoisoningDesc: Inject misleading data into responses to corrupt attacker analysis tools
mod.logPoisoningTip: Injects fake server info, internal paths, credentials, and terminal escape sequences into response headers. Attackers who log responses get corrupted data — fake routes to probe, terminal poison that corrupts CLI viewers, and misleading server fingerprints.
rules.logPoisonFakeHeadersDesc: Inject misleading X-Powered-By, X-Backend, X-Debug headers
rules.logPoisonTerminalDesc: Inject ANSI codes that corrupt CLI-based log viewers
rules.logPoisonFakePathsDesc: Include fake API routes and debug endpoints in responses
mod.underAttackDesc: Emergency kill-switch — disables all expensive countermeasures and returns minimal 429 responses to save resources
mod.underAttackTip: Activating this mode immediately stops tarpitting, zip bombs, log poisoning, and canary documents. All requests to tarpit endpoints receive an empty 429 response with Connection: close. Use during active Layer-7 DDoS attacks to minimize Vercel costs. The global circuit breaker in the edge middleware can also activate this automatically.
